scope: Unsigned implementation and correctness diagnostics; source-level arithmetic counts are not instruction counts or a measured speedup. Resource probes did not launch a GPU or benchmark job.
statement: The native scalar/SIMD center update replaces one field multiplication with one addition per intermediate coefficient update and zero-candidate detection is fused with evaluation. Producer checks report 15 core checks on stable and Rust 1.78 plus three CLI checks passing, including explicit polynomial products, mixed shifts and multi-tile padding cases; no runtime improvement has been measured.
